description: Bring home a revolutionary new kadai that completely transforms your kitchen experience, keeping you safe and happy in the kitchen. The lid can be placed in any position and closed safely. It also comes with a pressure indicator ensuring maximum safety. Use the unique glass lid to sauté, steam, fry, boil, cook and even serve. The Prestige Clip-On Svachh pressure kadai range is modular in design, which means you can use the same lid on all utensils in the range. care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: The gas tube must be checked regularly for wear or leaks. It must be replaced every two years. If it is damaged or if you notice a leak, the gas tube should be replaced immediately.
You must regularly check the gas tube for cracks or any other defect, thoroughly, Remember NOT to check gas leaks with a flame. Keep the tube away from heat.
Keep the gas tube clean.
Keep the burners clean at all times to make sure gas consumption is optimum. To clean the burner holes use a wire brush, If you clean the burners with water make sure that you dry them properly.
Please ensure that the auto-ignition unit is free from food particles/liquids as they may affect the ignition. When in doubt, please take your stove to the nearest service center.

Wipe the glass top and body with a dry cloth. If it is difficult to clean, use soapy water and then dry thoroughly with a dry cloth. Do not use hard scrubbers or any abrasive material as it may scratch the glass top and body.
Wash the pan support (trivet) in water and dry thoroughly before replacing it.
2 Years Warranty on the Product and 5 Years Warranty on Glass

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
1 Year Warranty

description: Presenting Prestige Cast iron, a range of contemporary cookware that helps you relive the original taste of food in a traditional way. care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base / sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. Normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets are not covered by the warranty.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.

care: The gas tube must be checked regularly for wear or leaks. It must be replaced every two years. If it is damaged or if you notice a leak, the gas tube should be replaced immediately.

title: Prestige Svachh Hard Anodised Spillage Control Pressure Cooker, (Black)
description: Bring home a cooker that helps you keep the kitchen clean and safe. The Prestige No-Mess cooker comes with a unique lid that contains any spillage that might occur during the course of cooking and prevents the messy liquid from dripping down. Revolutionize your cooking experience with this unique pressure cooker.
warranty: The manufacturer of Prestige Pressure Cooker offers a 5 year warranty for the Aluminium Pressure Cookers, Duo Models and 10 Year warranty for Stainless Steel Outer lid Alpha Deluxe/Svachh cookers from the original date of purchase and will, during this period, replace the Pressure Cooker free of charge, if there is any defect due to faulty material or workmanship, subject to the following terms and conditions.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base/sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

The warranty card duly stamped and signed by the dealer along with the cash memo, should be preserved and produced along with the unit sent to any of our Service Centres in India, otherwise, the claim will be treated as invalid.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

Its unique accessories make it ideal for preparing idlis and dhoklas while the round bottom makes it great for preparing curries and deep frying. What’s more, the base is also induction compatible. It's the perfect addition for your kitchen.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: The gas tube must be checked regularly for wear or leaks. It must be replaced every two years. If it is damaged or if you notice a leak, the gas tube should be replaced immediately.
You must regularly check the gas tube for cracks or any other defect, thoroughly, Remember NOT to check gas leaks with a flame. Keep the tube away from heat.
Keep the gas tube clean.
Keep the burners clean at all times to make sure gas consumption is optimum. To clean the burner holes use a wire brush, If you clean the burners with water make sure that you dry them properly.
Please ensure that the auto-ignition unit is free from food particles/liquids as they may affect the ignition. When in doubt, please take your stove to the nearest service center.

Wipe the glass top and body with a dry cloth. If it is difficult to clean, use soapy water and then dry thoroughly with a dry cloth. Do not use hard scrubbers or any abrasive material as it may scratch the glass top and body.
Wash the pan support (trivet) in water and dry thoroughly before replacing it.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

description: The all-new Prestige Deluxe Duo Plus Pressure Cooker comes with a hard anodised body and an elegant stainless steel lid. Which makes it a perfect addition to any kitchen. Here’s why its induction base is designed for even distribution of heat. What’s more, it also features a built-in safety indicator in the form of pressure indicators, a safety plug and a controlled gasket release system. With the glass lid, this Pressure Cooker can also be used to serve. So go ahead and bring home the Deluxe Duo Plus Pressure Cooker, it’s yet another Prestige product you can trust. Not only is it gas and induction compatible but comes with added safety features that make it one of the most reliable pressure cookers for your kitchen.
warranty: The manufacturer of Prestige Pressure Cooker offers a 5 year warranty for the Aluminium Pressure Cookers, Duo Models and 10 Year warranty for Stainless Steel Outer lid Alpha Deluxe/Svachh cookers from the original date of purchase and will, during this period, replace the Pressure Cooker free of charge, if there is any defect due to faulty material or workmanship, subject to the following terms and conditions.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base / sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. Normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets are not covered by the warranty.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

The warranty card duly stamped and signed by the dealer along with the cash memo, should be preserved and produced along with the unit sent to any of our Service Centres in India, otherwise the claim will be treated as invalid.

care: The gas tube must be checked regularly for wear or leaks. It must be replaced every two years. If it is damaged or if you notice a leak, the gas tube should be replaced immediately.

Keep the gas tube clean.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base / sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. Normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets are not covered by the warranty.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

description: Deluxe Plus Aluminium Pressure Cooker comes with induction base which makes it the most versatile pressure cooker available. warranty: The manufacturer of Prestige Pressure Cooker offers a 5 year warranty for the Aluminium Pressure Cookers, Duo Models and 10 Year warranty for Stainless Steel Outer lid Alpha Deluxe/Svachh cookers from the original date of purchase and will, during this period, replace the Pressure Cooker free of charge, if there is any defect due to faulty material or workmanship, subject to the following terms and conditions.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base/sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

It can work on any heat source and enables you to cook delicious dishes in a smart way at the highest level of safety through its Pressure Indicator which rises above the lid under pressure and drops when the pressure inside falls to zero, giving a visible indication to safely open the handi. The Deluxe plus Pressure Handi is aesthetically designed to give you the flavour of traditional Indian cooking.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Omega Deluxe Gas and Induction Compatible Omni Tawa + Fry-Pan Combo
description: Cook scrumptious meals using this Prestige Omega Deluxe 2 Pcs Cookware Set (Red). Made from aluminium, the tawa and fry pan come with an induction base and an ergonomically designed Bakelite handle for ease in use.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: The gas tube must be checked regularly for wear or leaks. It must be replaced every two years. If it is damaged or if you notice a leak, the gas tube should be replaced immediately.
You must regularly check the gas tube for cracks or any other defect, thoroughly, Remember NOT to check gas leaks with a flame. Keep the tube away from heat.
Keep the gas tube clean.
Keep the burners clean at all times to make sure gas consumption is optimum. To clean the burner holes use a wire brush, If you clean the burners with water make sure that you dry them properly.
Please ensure that the auto-ignition unit is free from food particles/liquids as they may affect the ignition. When in doubt, please take your stove to the nearest service center.

Wipe the glass top and body with a dry cloth. If it is difficult to clean, use soapy water and then dry thoroughly with a dry cloth. Do not use hard scrubbers or any abrasive material as it may scratch the glass top and body.
Wash the pan support (trivet) in water and dry thoroughly before replacing it.
2 Years Warranty

description: DO's Wash the cooker body/lid regularly with Soapy water. Do not use the caustic soda. Dry Immediately. Always store your pressure cooker with lid open. Read Recipe/Instruction Booklet carefully for more details. If after long use, the rubber gasket leaks, lightly stretch it diagonally to extend life. care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
1 Year Warranty

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Hard Anodised Cookware with Detachable Handle Fry Pan, 24cm, 1.7L (Black)
description: Experience new-age cooking with this Magna Hard Anodised Cookware. India's first Hard Anodised Cookware that works both on Gas Stoves and Induction Cook-tops. The non-toxic surface of the pan is resistant to high flames, non-staining and metal-spoon friendly, thus making it truly durable. Go on, use this cookware as a cook-and-serve, flaunt it, enjoy the attention and, of course, all the lip-smacking delicacies you can make with it.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: Please keep these important points in mind while using your Prestige Mixer Grinder.
Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
10 Years Warranty

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

title: Prestige Hard Anodised Plus Gas and Induction Compatible Kadai with Lid, (Black)
description: Experience new-age cooking with this Hard Anodised Plus Kadai Cookware, India's first Hard Anodised Cookware that works both on Gas Stoves and Induction Cooktops, The non-toxic surface of the pan is resistant to high flames, non-staining and metal-spoon friendly, thus making it truly durable. Go on, use this cookware as a cook-and-serve, flaunt it, enjoy the attention and, of course all the lip-smacking delicacies you can make with it.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Hard Anodised Plus Gas and Induction Compatible Sauce Pan with Glass Lid, (Black)
description: Experience new-age cooking with this Sauce Pan. India’s first Hard Anodised cookware that works both on Gas Stoves and Induction Cooktops. The non-toxic surface of the pan is resistant to high fames, non-staining and metal-spoon friendly, thus making it truly durable. Go on, use this cookware as a cook-and-serve, flaunt it, and enjoy the attention.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

title: Prestige Platina Non-stick Stainless Steel Unique Impact Forged Bottom Kadai with Glass Lid (Silver)
keyFeatures: 5 Years Warranty on Product and 1 Year Warranty on Non-stick Coating
description: The Platina Non-stick is a unique four layered coated stainless steel cookware that uses less oil, is scratch resistant and metal spoon friendly. It comes with a Unique Impact Forged Bottom, ensuring food cooks fast and evenly. Its Sturdy Heat Resistant Handles allows for easier handling while cooking. Superior in every way, the Platina Non-stick is the perfect addition to your kitchen.
warranty: 5 Years Warranty on Product and 1 Year Warranty on Non-stick Coating
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

Glass Lid With Steam Vent - Look+Cook
description: Level up your kitchen with a premium copper colour coated series of cookware, the Prestige Cuprus. The special coating ensures less oil consumption while cooking, which means you can enjoy your favourite dishes for years without worry. This mesterfully crafted cookware also guarantees even heating and next-gen scratch resistance. So, get ready to choose your colour of health now. Not only is it gas and induction compatible but comes with added safety features that make it one of the most reliable cookware for your kitchen.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

title: Prestige Svachh Aluminium Anti Bulge Induction Base Pressure Cooker (Silver)
keyFeatures: Unique Deep Lid which Controls Spillage
description: Bring home a cooker that helps you keep the kitchen clean and safe. The Prestige Svachh cooker comes with a unique lid that contains any spillage that might occur during the course of cooking and prevents the messy liquid from dripping down. Moreover, it comes with an added safety features that make it one of the most reliable cookers for your kitchen.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base/sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

The warranty card duly stamped and signed by the dealer along with the cash memo, should be preserved and produced along with the unit sent to any of our Service Centres in India, otherwise, the claim will be treated as invalid.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Magna Hard Anodised Cookware with Detachable Handle Kitchen Set
description: Experience new-age cooking with this Magna Hard Anodised Cookware. India's first Hard Anodised Cookware that works both on Gas Stoves and Induction Cook-tops. The non-toxic surface of the pan is resistant to high flames, non-staining and metal-spoon friendly, thus making it truly durable. Go on, use this cookware as a cook-and-serve, flaunt it, enjoy the attention and, of course, all the lip-smacking delicacies you can make with it.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Swish 2000W Easy Store Design Induction Cooktop (Black) with Omega Deluxe Induction Compatible Non-stick Kitchen Set 3 Pcs BYK, Maroon
care: Please switch off the power and remove the plug from the wall outlet.
Before cleaning, make sure that the appliance is cool. Do not clean the appliance when it is hot. Clean the Cooktop and the control panel with a damp cloth.
Do not wash the Induction Cooktop in running water. Do not immerse the Induction cooktop in water.
To clean the black glass panel, first wipe it with a wet cloth. Then wipe it with a sponge using mild detergent and finally wipe it to dry with a soft cloth.
Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.

description: The Prestige Popular Svachh Stainless Steel Pressure Cooker brings the best cooking experience to your kitchen. Its unique design helps you cook faster, and the innovative Deep-lid keeps your kitchen clean, at the same time. This pressure cooker comes with an induction base and a host of other top-of-the-line features. care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
2 Years Warranty

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.
The blades are sharp, so handle them carefully while cleaning.
To get the most from your Prestige Mixer Grinder, plan out your schedule in advance.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base / sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. Normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets are not covered by the warranty.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

The warranty card duly stamped and signed by the dealer along with the cash memo, should be preserved and produced along with the unit sent to any of our Service Centres in India, otherwise the claim will be treated as invalid.

title: PRESTIGE DURASTONE HARD ANODISED Non-stick COOKWARE DEEP KADAI 24cm (3 LITRE) WITH GLASS LID
description: Here's yet another winning cookware ensemble from Prestige — Durastone. This Hard Anodised Stone Finish Cookware boasts of a unique design that compliments your kitchen interiors. The highlight is a stone finish with Non-stick coating that enhances the products appearance. It is powered with extra thick pans for even heating and durability, resulting in a trouble-free performance and elegant looks, for life.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.
