description: Bring home the perfect blend of strength, safety, and style with the Prestige 5 Litre Triply Svachh Outer Lid Pressure Cooker (Handi). Designed for superior performance and everyday convenience, this cooker combines innovative Triply technology with Prestige’s trusted safety standards. Built with a superior Triply body, it features three durable layers — a 304 18/8 stainless-steel inner surface for hygienic, corrosion-resistant cooking; a thick aluminium core for faster and uniform heat distribution; and a 430-grade stainless-steel outer base for induction compatibility and long-lasting durability. The Svachh Deep Lid design minimizes starchy boil-over and keeps your cooktop spotless, while the Handi shape makes it ideal for biryanis, curries, and gravies that need consistent simmering and rich flavour. For added safety, the cooker is equipped with a Triple Safety System — including a Metallic Safety Plug (MSP) to release excess pressure, a Gasket Release System (GRS) for backup safety, and a Visual Pressure Indicator (VPI) for easy monitoring. Compatible with both gas and induction cooktops, this cooker is as versatile as it is dependable. The ergonomic handles offer a firm, comfortable grip, ensuring secure handling during use. Backed by Prestige’s 5-year manufacturer warranty and ISI certification, this cooker is built to deliver years of safe, reliable cooking performance.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Glory Stainless Steel Cookware Kadai With Glass Lid
description: Elegant design and high performance come together with the new Prestige Glory stainless—steel cookware, that gives you added durability with a heavy thick gauge, improved performance, and long—lasting looks. This cookware comes with Unique Triply Bottom, that ensures your food cooks fast and fries evenly. This cookware is also oven safe & induction compatible, making it truly versatile.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

title: Prestige Ceraglide Ceramic Coating Non-stick Aluminium Cookware Deep Kadai
description: Elevate your cooking experience with our ceramic cookware. The ceramic coating reduces oil usage, while PFOA & PFAS free design ensures safe cooking. High heating guarantees even and a speedy cooking. Durability, easy maintenance, and induction compatibility cater to modern kitchens, embracing new-age, health-conscious cooking at its finest.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.

title: Prestige Ceraglide Ceramic Coating Non-stick Aluminium Cookware Wok
description: Elevate your cooking experience with our ceramic cookware. The ceramic coating reduces oil usage, while PFOA & PFAS free design ensures safe cooking. High heating guarantees even and a speedy cooking. Durability, easy maintenance, and induction compatibility cater to modern kitchens, embracing new-age, health-conscious cooking at its finest.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

title: Prestige Svachh Pressure Cooker
keyFeatures: Triply Body for Durability & Even Heat Distribution
description: Looking for a durable and safe pressure cooker that gives you a perfect cooking experience? The Prestige Svachh Tri-ply pressure cooker brings you the best of all worlds. Its unique design keeps your kitchen clean as the innovative Deep Svachh Lid controls spillage of messy, starchy water, while the Tri-ply adds to the durability, long-lasting good looks and improved performance. It has a Pressure Indicator that pops up when pressure's built inside and the Auto-Lock Mechanism, a safety feature, activates immediately to ensure the lid can't be opened. With Prestige Svachh Tri-ply pressure cooker, you can be assured of even heating, faster cooking, and a spick and span kitchen each time with no compromise.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.

title: Prestige Nakshatra 5+3 Combi Pack
description: The all new Prestige Nakshatra Aluminium Pressure Cooker - designed and engineered to last longer. With unbeatable safety features and stylish looks, Prestige Nakshatra aluminium pressure cooker adds to the aesthetics of your kitchen.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: Please keep these important points in mind while using your Prestige Mixer Grinder.
Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.

To get the most from your Prestige Mixer Grinder, plan out your schedule in advance. Give dry grinding jobs priority over wet grinding jobs. Combine jobs to reduce the necessity for repeated cleaning.
In dry grinding, the jar may get heated up due to friction. This is nothing to do with the motor and is quite natural. Your jar will cool down with time.

It is normal for the mixer grinder to get a little discolored, especially when used with items like turmeric. To avoid this, make sure that items like turmeric do not come in contact with the mixer body.
Do not run the mixer grinder for more than 5 minutes continuously. Give a gap of 2 minutes if you need to use it for more time.

title: Prestige Omega Marble Aluminium Non-stick Cookware - Fry Pan
description: Introducing Prestige Omega Marble Cookware with Non-stick coating which makes your everyday diet a little healthier. With its extra thick durable body and sleek rubberised handles, the Prestige cookware looks good and cooks even better. Add to that it's spoon-friendly and extremely durable body makes it perfect for every kitchen.
care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: Please keep these important points in mind while using your Prestige Mixer Grinder.
Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.
The blades are sharp, so handle them carefully while cleaning.
To get the most from your Prestige Mixer Grinder, plan out your schedule in advance.
Give dry grinding jobs priority over wet grinding jobs. Combine jobs to reduce the necessity for repeated cleaning.
In dry grinding, the jar may get heated up due to friction. This is nothing to do with the motor and is quite natural. Your jar will cool down with time.

It is normal for the mixer grinder to get a little discolored, especially when used with items like turmeric. To avoid this, make sure that items like turmeric do not come in contact with the mixer body.
Do not run the mixer grinder for more than 5 minutes continuously. Give a gap of 2 minutes if you need to use it for more time.
2 Years Warranty

care: Please keep these important points in mind while using your Prestige Mixer Grinder.
Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.

Wash the pan support (trivet) in water and dry thoroughly before replacing it.

description: Made using the best quality Aluminium, Prestige Deluxe Duo Plus Pressure Cookers are the perfect addition to any kitchen. Here's why, its unique induction base is designed for even distribution of heat and is also induction compatible. What's more, it also features a built-in safety indicator in the form of pressure indicators, safety plug and controlled gasket-release system. So go ahead and bring.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: Please keep these important points in mind while using your Prestige Mixer Grinder.
Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.
The blades are sharp, so handle them carefully while cleaning.

To get the most from your Prestige Mixer Grinder, plan out your schedule in advance. Give dry grinding jobs priority over wet grinding jobs. Combine jobs to reduce the necessity for repeated cleaning.
In dry grinding, the jar may get heated up due to friction. This is nothing to do with the motor and is quite natural. Your jar will cool down with time.

It is normal for the mixer grinder to get a little discolored, especially when used with items like turmeric. To avoid this, make sure that items like turmeric do not come in contact with the mixer body.
Do not run the mixer grinder for more than 5 minutes continuously. Give a gap of 2 minutes if you need to use it for more time.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.

title: Prestige 5 L, 3 L, 2 L Outer Lid Induction Bottom Pressure Cooker (Hard Anodized)
description: Bring home a cooker that helps you keep the kitchen clean and safe. The Prestige No-Mess cooker comes with a unique lid that contains any spillage that might occur during the course of cooking and prevents the messy liquid from dripping down. Moreover it with added safety features that make it one of the most reliable cookers for your kitchen.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
2 Year Warranty

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base / sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. Normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets are not covered by the warranty.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

The warranty card duly stamped and signed by the dealer along with the cash memo, should be preserved and produced along with the unit sent to any of our Service Centres in India, otherwise the claim will be treated as invalid.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
The Pressure Cooker is used properly in accordance with the instructions given in the Instruction manual.
The warranty does not cover any Pressure Cooker attended to by others excepting those from our Authorised Service Centres.

Replacement parts such as Safety Plug, Handles, Screws, Weight Valve, Vent Tube, Gasket, Pressure Indicator with Grommet and Nuts are not covered by this warranty as these parts require periodic renewal.

Damage caused by overheating, dry heating, soiling, scratches, pittings discolouration and separation of the induction plate base / sandwich cladded base from the body and body bulge due to dry heating and excessive heat are excluded from the warranty. Normal wear and tear to the fittings and gaskets are not covered by the warranty.
The decision of the manufacturer is final in all cases of complaints.

The warranty card duly stamped and signed by the dealer along with the cash memo, should be preserved and produced along with the unit sent to any of our Service Centres in India, otherwise the claim will be treated as invalid.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

HEXA MAGIC HONEYCOMB STRUCTURE: Innovative honeycomb-patterned surface protects the ceramic coating, reduces direct ladle contact, and keeps the cookware scratch-resistant, metal-spoon friendly, and looking new for longer.
CERAMIC COATING: 100% PFOA- & PFAS-free ceramic coating for safer cooking—perfect for healthy, everyday meals.
HEALTHY, LOW-OIL COOKING: Smooth ceramic surface allows easy food release and requires less oil, helping you cook nutritious, guilt-free dishes while preserving flavour and nutrients.
GAS & INDUCTION COMPATIBLE: Works efficiently on both gas stoves and induction cooktops, offering versatility and convenience for every modern kitchen.
EASY TO CLEAN & DISHWASHER SAFE: Designed for effortless cleaning — compatible with all standard dishwashers, ensuring quick and hassle-free maintenance after every use.

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

description: Introducing Nakshatra Cute Svachh, a pressure cooker that helps you dish out great food and looks stunning as well. The wide base makes stirring easy and the unique Svachh lid controls and contains any spillage that might occur during the course of cooking, keeping your kitchen safer and cleaner than ever before. The wide base is also more energy efficient for fuel saving and increases the speed of cooking. The three-layer sandwich bottom ensures even heat distribution and also prevents any hot spots. The heavy gauge body and the mini metallic safety plug ensures utmost safety. Now, you can impress people with your culinary skills and your cooker is going to fetch you amazing compliments.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

title: Prestige Popular Svachh Aluminium Pressure Cooker 7.5 L
keyFeatures: Controls Spillage: Our innovative deep-lid design prevents the starchy water from flowing down the cooker, so that your kitchen is always clean and easy to maintain.
Metallic Safety Plug: Releases excess steam when pressure rises beyond a safe level.
Virgin Aluminium: Made using superior quality virgin aluminium to ensure enhanced safety.

Controlled Gasket-Release System: When there is excess build up of pressure within the pressure cooker, the gasket bulges out through the slot present towards the side in the lid of the pressure cooker. The pressure gets released out through the hole on the lid.
Comfortable Handles: Ergonomically designed for easy handling.
description: The Prestige Popular Svachh Aluminium Pressure Cooker brings the best cooking experience to your kitchen. Its unique design helps you cook faster, and the innovative Deep-lid keeps your kitchen clean, at the same time. Manufactured from Virgin Aluminium to ensure zero contamination, the cooker boasts of high quality raw materials. Perfected over a period of time with the trademark Prestige engineering, expect the very best with up-to-date innovations and features. Add to that, the elegant design and splendid finish, the cooker is a sheer pleasure to cook with.
care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.
Do not use glass lids that have cracks, chips, or scratches, and do not attempt to make repairs to damaged cookware.
Handles and knobs can get very hot under certain conditions. Always have pot holders or gloves available for use.
When cooking, make sure handles are not positioned over other hot burners.Some handles and knobs that are attached to screws may loosen over time. If this occurs, they should be retightened.
Wooden or plastic utensils are recommended for most Non-stick surfaces. Metal spoons used on Metal spoon-friendly Non-stick coating shall be without sharp edges.

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
5 Years Warranty

care: This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
1 Years Warranty

description: Introducing the Prestige Elliot 750 Watt 3 Jar Mixer Grinder, built for homes that want power, versatility and elegant design in one compact appliance. care: Please keep these important points in mind while using your Prestige Mixer Grinder.
Before the first use and if using after a long time, please check to see if the motor shaft rotates smoothly, and also the jars should be checked for free movement.
The blades are sharp, so handle them carefully while cleaning.

To get the most from your Prestige Mixer Grinder, plan out your schedule in advance. Give dry grinding jobs priority over wet grinding jobs. Combine jobs to reduce the necessity for repeated cleaning.
In dry grinding, the jar may get heated up due to friction. This is nothing to do with the motor and is quite natural. Your jar will cool down with time.

It is normal for the mixer grinder to get a little discolored, especially when used with items like turmeric. To avoid this, make sure that items like turmeric do not come in contact with the mixer body.
Do not run the mixer grinder for more than 5 minutes continuously. Give a gap of 2 minutes if you need to use it for more time.
2 Year Warranty

care: The gas tube must be checked regularly for wear or leaks. It must be replaced every two years. If it is damaged or if you notice a leak, the gas tube should be replaced immediately.
You must regularly check the gas tube for cracks or any other defect, thoroughly, Remember NOT to check gas leaks with a flame. Keep the tube away from heat.
Keep the gas tube clean.
Keep the burners clean at all times to make sure gas consumption is optimum. To clean the burner holes use a wire brush, If you clean the burners with water make sure that you dry them properly.
Please ensure that the auto-ignition unit is free from food particles/liquids as they may affect the ignition. When in doubt, please take your stove to the nearest service center.

Wipe the glass top and body with a dry cloth. If it is difficult to clean, use soapy water and then dry thoroughly with a dry cloth. Do not use hard scrubbers or any abrasive material as it may scratch the glass top and body.
Wash the pan support (trivet) in water and dry thoroughly before replacing it.
This appliance cooks under pressure. Improper use may result in scalding injury. Make certain the unit is properly closed before operating. See “Operating Instructions.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not fill the unit over 2/3 full. When cooking foods that expand during cooking such as rice or dried vegetable, do not fill the unit over 1/2 full. Overfilling may cause a risk of clogging the vent tube (vent pipe) and developing excess pressure.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Do not open the pressure cooker until the unit has cooled and internal pressure has been reduced. If the handles of the body and lid are difficult to push apart, this indicates that the cooker is still pressurized. Do not use force to open the cooker. The pressure remaining in the cooker can be dangerous.

After the normal cooking pressure has been reached, reduce the heat to just above the sim position so that all the liquid inside the cooker which creates the steam, does not evaporate. Ensure the handles are tight. If found loose please tighten the same before use. For safe pressure cooking, cracked, broken, or charred handles should be replaced immediately.
It is recommended to replace with a genuine Mini Metallic safety plug (Fusible safety relief device) and gasket after one year of everyday use for safe cooking.

Do not dry heat the Pressure Cooker. It may lead to the fusing of the safety plug, bulging of the body base, and separation of the Induction base / Cladded base thereby damaging the Cooker. Do not put the pressure cooker inside the dishwasher for washing.
Use the cookware in accordance with the instructions.
Before first use, remove the sticker on the coating surface if any, Wash the cookware in warm, soapy water.
Select the proper burner size so that the heat touches only the bottom of the cookware and does not climb up the side walls. A few Ranges are not Induction compatible, Check the product manual.
As soon as the boiling point is reached, the heating should be lowered. Continuous high heat may cause discoloration.
Use low heat when heating up oils, as oils can quickly overheat and cause a fire.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

For cookware with a Non-stick interior, it is recommended to “season” the pan prior to first use. Heat each pan on low for 30 seconds, remove from heat, and put one tablespoon of vegetable oil in each pan. Rub the oil over the entire surface with a paper towel. Repeat after every 10 dishwasher cycles or if accidental overheating occurs.

Use low to medium heat with your Non-stick cookware. Aluminium cookware conducts heat extremely quickly and evenly. High heat may damage your Non-stick cookware, and this type of damage is not covered under the warranty.
Never let cookware boil dry or leave an empty piece of cookware on a heated burner.

Cookies are small pieces of information that are stored by your browser on your computer's hard drive. Our cookies do not contain any personally identifying information, but they do enable us to identify you in case you have visited us earlier and to store items in your shopping cart between visits. Most Web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually change your browser to prevent that. Even without a cookie, you can still use most of the features in our store, including placing items in your shopping cart and purchasing them. title: Hassle-Free Returns: TTK Prestige Online Store Return Policy (part 1)
text: Cancellation Return & Refund Policy Order Cancellation - Only Full Cancellation allowed. Partial Order Cancellation is not allowed. - To place cancel request call the customer care helpline within 12 working hours of placing the order. Order Returns - In case product is received physically damaged during shipment, click a picture and email to customer service team for assessment within 24 hours of receiving the shipment. - We only accept returns if the item shipped to you is defective or damaged. The item should be returned to us within 7 days from the delivery date in original packaging. The product should be in unused condition. We will send you a new replacement unit as soon as we receive the return package. - When you return your product, indicate the reason for your return in a short note. Put the item along with the invoice and the note with the order number into a secure package. Affix our address (send only to sender address as seen in the invoice / delivery challan) and send it through a reliable courier and email us the consignment details. - Please note that we will provide refund / return facility only for products bought from our online store shop.ttkprestige.com / judge.ttkprestige.com and not for orders from physical stores or other online stores. - In case of wrong product ordering (e.g 180mm tava instead of 220mm Tava), you can place a new order, for a different product but from the same category, of equal or higher selling price.

title: Hassle-Free Returns: TTK Prestige Online Store Return Policy (part 2)
text: Send back the wrongly ordered product with following remark "Wrong product ordered. New order no - XXX" Also send us an email with the full details of both the orders along with your bank account IFSC details for transferring payment. We will initiate online fund transfer for the returned product amount, within 7 working days of receiving the wrong product. For all product/s supplied by the Associates, the Customer shall open, inspect the ordered Product and accept the delivery, after ensuring that the Product is delivered in good working condition. For example – In case of Mixer Grinder, the Customer shall plug and operate the same. Once the Product is accepted, post inspection as above (for supplies by the Associates), the Customer will not be entitled to return the same. Order Refund - All accepted cases of refunds, would be processed to the same account of the Customer, from which the purchase was made. In case of Cash On Delivery (“COD”), the refund would be processed to the Bank account of the Customer, after the Customer provides the necessary details and documents. There will be no cash refund. Repair / Warranty issues - In case of any kind of malfunctioning or defect in product, post acceptance of delivery of the Product by the Associates and/or on expiry of return period, the same would be addressed by TTK Prestige, as per the terms of Warranty, through its Service Centers.

title: Hassle-Free Returns: TTK Prestige Online Store Return Policy (part 3)
text: The Customer shall either register Product related complaints on the Toll Free Customer Care number / by approaching the nearest authorized service center/s.
